title: 第一卷 第15章 今夜他必须死第一卷 第16章 断空斩
lines: “库……库房！你想干什么！”罗麟瞳孔瞪大。
秦绝眼眸一眯，右手微抖了一下。
斩神刀锋利的刃口，顿时在罗麟的脖子上，割出了一道血口子。
“啊！”罗麟吓得大叫，忙道：“好，我领你去！”
“这就对了。”秦绝冷笑一声，挪开了刀锋。
罗麟一咬牙，扭身领着秦绝朝着库房走去。
另一边，三大家族的人，气势汹汹的跑回王家。
一进门，王圣就看到了躺在血泊里的四儿子王松。
“儿啊！”
“秦绝那狗杂碎呢！”
“秦……秦绝去了库房！”
“那你们这群废物还杵在这里做什么！还不跟我去杀了那狗杂碎！”
王家众人怒吼喊着，朝着库房方向奔冲过去。
如今三大家族强者齐聚，他们也有了底气。
可当他们冲到王家库房时，只看到了王烁的尸体。
“二弟！”王霄目光赤红，看着惨死的王烁，悲呼一声。
“老夫在此立誓，今日不杀秦绝，誓不为人——”
王霄歇斯底里的长吼一声，咆哮的声音，震荡了整个王家！
“不对！秦绝不在王家了，那他去了何处！”
罗望的脸，瞬间白了！
韩风的脸，也是颤抖了起来。
“快，快回去！”
“王兄，现在不是悲伤的时候，那小子要么已经跑路了，要么就是去了我罗家或者是韩家！咱们不能让这小子一一偷了家，王兄若想报仇，还请暂停悲伤，与我们一道过去寻那小子才是！”罗开岳连忙道。
如果秦绝真去了罗家，他怕自己一个人不是秦绝的对手，所以必须要把王家人带上，才能有几分底气。
王霄咬了咬牙：“走！”
他也明白，单靠王家之力，想报仇几乎没可能。
“为防那小子又跑了，我们三人还是先行一步为好。”罗开岳忙道。
“好！”韩文昭、王霄都没意见。
毕竟现在谁也不知道，秦绝是去了罗家，还是去了韩家。
韩文昭和罗开岳的心里都急。
当即，三道人影率先掠出王家。
随后，三大家族的其他人，紧跟着冲出了王家，但后面这些人的速度，明显要慢上一大截。
三家一百多人，在夜色笼罩的凤州城里，来回狂奔，这动静，自然惊动了不少人。
赵家。
赵济揉了揉太阳穴，脑门有点发热。
“这孩子，怎么这般冲动……”
content_en:
"Warehouse... warehouse! What do you want to do!" Luo Lin's pupils widened.
Qin Jue's eyes narrowed and his right hand shook slightly.
The sharp edge of the God-Slaying Sword immediately cut a bloody gash on Luo Lin's neck.
"Ah!" Luo Lin screamed in fright, and hurriedly said: "Okay, I'll take you there!"
"That's right." Qin Jue sneered and moved the blade away.
Luo Lin gritted his teeth, turned around and led Qin Jue towards the warehouse.
On the other side, people from the three major families ran back to the Wang family angrily.
As soon as he entered the door, Wang Sheng saw his fourth son Wang Song lying in a pool of blood.
"Son!"
"Where's that bastard Qin Jue!"
"Qin...Qin Jue went to the warehouse!"
"Then what are you doing here, you losers! Why don't you follow me and kill that bastard!"
"Kill!"
Everyone in the Wang family roared and rushed towards the warehouse.
Now that the three powerful families have gathered together, they have confidence.
But when they rushed to the Wang family's warehouse, they only saw Wang Shuo's body.
"Second brother!" Wang Xiao's eyes were red, looking at the tragic death of Wang Shuo, and he cried out sadly.
"I swear here that I will not kill Qin Jue today, and I will not be a human being-"
Wang Xiao roared hysterically, and the roar shook the entire Wang family!
"No! Qin is definitely not in the Wang family anymore, so where did he go!"
Luo Wang's face turned pale instantly!
Han Feng's face also trembled.
"Quick, go back quickly!"
"Brother Wang, now is not the time to be sad. That kid has either run away or gone to my Luo family or Han family! We can't let this kid steal every house one by one. If Brother Wang wants to take revenge, please suspend your sorrow and go with us to find that kid!" Luo Kaiyue said quickly.
If Qin Jue really went to the Luo family, he was afraid that he alone would not be Qin Jue's opponent, so he had to bring the Wang family with him to have some confidence.
Wang Xiao gritted his teeth: "Let's go!"
He also understood that it was almost impossible to seek revenge with the help of the Wang family alone.
"In case that kid runs away again, it's better for the three of us to take the first step." Luo Kaiyue said hurriedly.
"Okay!" Neither Han Wenzhao nor Wang Xiao had any objections.
After all, no one knows now whether Qin Jue went to the Luo family or the Han family.
Han Wenzhao and Luo Kaiyue were both anxious.
Immediately, three figures took the lead in rushing out of Wang's house.
Then, other people from the three major families rushed out of the Wang family, but the speed of these people behind them was obviously much slower.
More than a hundred people from three families were running back and forth in the night-shrouded Fengzhou City. This movement naturally alarmed many people.
Zhao family.
Zhao Ji rubbed his temples and his forehead felt a little hot.
"Why is this kid so impulsive..."
